name: an immediate, Handi's
what: its wait's CurAction left at BN5's 7 (BN6's bubbled state) where the recipe makes it 9 (movs r0,#7 before its setAttack0)

name: a rebased call
what: the veneer of its panel's pick (BN5 0x08012DCC, BN6 0x08015FDC: a panel of its own side at random) rebased to the routine after it (0x08016004, a pick among the other side's panels, which draws as many numbers)

name: a shifted RNG call
what: its draws (GetPositiveSignedRNG, BN6 0x08001532) shifted onto the second word (GetPositiveSignedRNGSecondary, 0x08001562): the replay finds no draw of the reference's to give them, and they draw what they find
